summary: Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc. filed an 8-K on June 22, 2026, announcing a press release unveiling its second-half launch of the FF EAI Robot World, including a new mobile manipulator called the All-New Futurist, priced at $89,900, and a preview of its EAI Robotics Industrial Ecosystem at Automate in Chicago. The filing is furnished under Item 8.01 for Other Events and includes details on robot shipments expected to exceed 100 units in June. This is a routine product announcement, not a special situation.
